subject: Audit logs & access evidence — next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@fincobank.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.j@fincobank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logs & access evidence — next steps

Hi Priya / Alex —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the audit/logging items you flagged:

- Requirement: CSV export of access logs showing who accessed what and when (API key / user identity, resource, action, request_id, timestamp).
- Retention: you mentioned a 7-year retention for some records and a shorter operational retention for others; need to confirm which classes fall into each bucket.
- PII: you want guidance on which fields we can mask/omit and what we can provide as hashed identifiers.
- Residency: logs need to be exportable from US-based region only for this account.
- Evidence: FinCo will need an evidence package (sample export + description of controls + any SOC2 attestation we can share).

Attached: audit_logs_sample.csv (sample export) and evidence_request_template.docx (your team can fill the checklist).

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm the exact fields and retention buckets by end of day Thu (7/23)?
2) We can produce a scoped export and evidence package for review by Mon 8/3 — does that timeline work?
3) If useful, we can set a short verification call to walk through a sample export and redaction options.

Let me know preferred time windows for a call (I can coordinate with Marissa).

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Sharma <priya@fincobank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.j@fincobank.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Audit logs & access evidence — next steps

Jordan —

Thanks for the summary. Confirming details from our side:

- Fields required in export: timestamp (UTC), request_id, api_key_id, requesting_user_email (we prefer a hashed identifier if storing cleartext is not possible), target_resource (model id / deployment id), action (generate/embeddings/download), response_size_bytes, client_ip (first 3 octets can be masked), region.
- Export format: CSV or Parquet preferred.
- Retention: Legal requires some logs retained for 7 years; operational logs may be kept for 90 days. We need an agreed mapping of log types to retention policy.
- Access evidence: We need a sample export that includes an explanation of the schema plus a statement of where logs are stored (region) and how they can be exported. If you have a SOC2 report or SOC2 summary for the period covering the account, please include.
- PII: We can accept hashed user identifiers for exported logs, but internal investigations may require help from your CS/infra team to map hashes back in exceptional cases — please describe the process and controls for that.

Attaching our internal requirements PDF; happy to iterate. 8/3 for a sample export looks fine — can you share a calendar invite for a 30-min call?

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Head of Risk & Compliance | FinCo Bank
Attachment: fincobank_audit_requirements.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@fincobank.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs & access evidence — next steps

Priya —

Appreciate the clear list. To address each point from Redwood's side:

- Export schema: we can produce exports containing the fields you listed (timestamp UTC, request_id, api_key_id, requesting_user_identifier (hashed or plaintext where permitted), target_resource, action, response_size_bytes, client_ip (partial mask), region). We'll deliver both CSV and Parquet samples if you'd like.
- Retention: by default Redwood retains request-level logs for 90 days in hosted mode. For customers with regulatory requirements we support scheduled exports and options to store logs in the customer's cloud project (or Dedicated/Private deployments) where longer retention is possible. For FinCo's 7-year legal requirement, we recommend either (a) periodic exports into your own S3/GCS bucket, or (b) a Private deployment where your org controls retention policies. We'll include a documented workflow for option (a) in the evidence package.
- PII handling: we can hash user identifiers at export time and provide a controlled process for mapping in escalation scenarios. That mapping requires an authorized request with audit trail and approval from our security team — we'll include the approvals workflow in the package.
- Residency: we confirm FinCo's account can be served from the US region; export keys and snapshots will be generated and stored only in the requested region.
- Evidence & attestations: attached is redwood-access-logging-overview.pdf which describes fields and tooling. We can also provide SOC2 summary and our compliance whitepaper; I'll follow up with the specific doc links.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Jordan / Ben to produce a scoped export sample (synthetic/anonymized) and an evidence package by Mon 2026-08-03.
- Set a 30-min verification call with your team to review the sample on the same day.

Priya — can you confirm who on your side should be on the verification call? Also confirm whether you prefer CSV or Parquet first.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-access-logging-overview.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@fincobank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs & access evidence — next steps

Priya —

Thanks — confirms alignment. Quick summary of agreed items and logistics:

- Deliverables by Mon 2026-08-03: (1) scoped sample export (CSV + Parquet) with hashed user identifiers, (2) evidence package including export schema, retention mapping, PII handling process, and SOC2 summary, (3) a short runbook describing how FinCo can request mapping in exceptional investigations.
- Residency: exports will be generated from the US region and we will provide a signed attestation stating that no export artifacts will be stored outside the US for this job.
- Verification call: proposed 30-min slot on Mon 2026-08-03 at 10:00 AM ET — sending a calendar invite now.
- Action items:
  - Jordan: coordinate the scoped export and invite.
  - Marissa: produce the evidence package and attach SOC2 summary links.
  - Ben: on standby for any technical questions during the verification call.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfG-fincobank-audit and HubSpot record: contact 00345 / deal D-84521.

If anything changes on your side (participants or required fields), flag it here and we'll adjust.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
